title: Continuous Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP) Therapy For Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA)

sleep_test_documented.description: A completed diagnostic sleep test (attended polysomnogram or home sleep test) is documented; a planned or scheduled study does not count

ahi.description: Diagnostic apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) or respiratory disturbance index (RDI), overall events per hour. Not an arousal index, not a position-only value and not an AHI measured on CPAP during titration

osa_symptoms.description: Documented excessive daytime sleepiness, impaired cognition, mood disorders or insomnia

cardiovascular_comorbidity.description: Documented hypertension, ischemic heart disease or history of stroke

criteria.policy_text: A positive diagnosis of OSA for the coverage of CPAP must include a clinical evaluation and a positive attended PSG performed in a sleep laboratory, or an unattended HST
AHI or RDI greater than or equal to 15 events per hour
AHI or RDI greater than or equal to 5 events and less than or equal to 14 events per hour
with documented symptoms of excessive daytime sleepiness, impaired cognition, mood disorders or insomnia
or documented hypertension, ischemic heart disease, or history of stroke
